name: Unbreakable Focus cuts the cooldown of Gavels and Horusath Blast by 20% (#1138)
contract: Unbreakable Focus 704945 (SpellFamilyName 33) has one live effect: SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN) and EffectBasePoints -21 -> real -20, and EffectSpellClassMask word 2 bits 0x20|0x40 (96). Every 'Gavel' (Gavel of Light 800611, Gavel of Grace 800614, Gavel of Wrath 800617) carries SpellFamilyFlags_2 0x20, and Horusath Blast (500154) carries SpellFamilyFlags_2 0x40 -- together exactly the shipped mask, so both named abilities are affected. Gavel of Light has no RecoveryTime, only CategoryRecoveryTime 5000 (its own tooltip: 'Shares a cooldown with other Gavels'); Horusath Blast has RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime both 25000. Player::SendSpellCooldown applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to whichever of rec/catrec is nonzero via ApplySpellMod, a PCT-type op that multiplies the base by (100 + mod)/100 -- 25000 -> 20000 and 5000 -> 4000. The 'spell_modifier' query metric calls this same native Player::ApplySpellMod(spell, SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, base) path directly, without casting or needing a target. Native handlers only; regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without the talent Horusath Blast keeps its full 25 second cooldown
Unbreakable Focus cuts Horusath Blast's cooldown by 20% to 20 seconds
Without the talent Gavel of Light keeps its full 5 second shared cooldown
Unbreakable Focus cuts Gavel of Light's shared cooldown by 20% to 4 seconds
